stem: Maggie wants to add another detail to help build the ideas in the second paragraph (sentences 8–12). Which of these could follow sentence 10 and add to the main idea of this paragraph?

options.label: A
options.text: I wonder whether there are other things people find to do with rhino horns.

options.label: B
options.text: In parts of Asia, people believe that these horns can cure all kinds of diseases.

options.label: C
options.text: One type of rhinoceros, the black rhino, can live up to five days without water.

options.label: D
options.text: That’s why a lot of people are interested in rhino horns.
